summary: Per-frame screenshot handler. Scans the input keycode array word_7CB21C (dword_7CB218 entries) for key code 88 ('X'); when pressed, saves the screen via sub_551FD0 using the season directory dword_5EC478 (or the fallback byte_5EA438 when empty) and screen dimensions dword_8B8DD4/dword_8B8DD8. On success it localizes 'Screen Saved' (aScreenSaved) through BinarySearchInStringTable into buffer byte_5EC4CC and renders the message with TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Regardless of the key path it always runs CameraViewportRenderSetup on unk_8AFFC8, VehicleVisibilityCulling on this, and returns sub_557120(dword_8AFE88).

local_names.v3: cursor into the word_7CB21C keycode array
local_names.v4: screenshot output path: dword_5EC478 or fallback byte_5EA438
local_names.v5: string copy index into aScreenSaved / byte_5EC4CC

operations.description: Guard on input scan: proceed only if dword_7CB218 > 0.
do-while scan over the keycode array starting at word_7CB21C, iterating while v1 < dword_7CB218.
Guard on the current keycode: trigger screenshot path only when *v3 == 88 (ASCII 'X').
Select the screenshot directory: v4 = dword_5EC478, falling back to byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC478 is null.
Call sub_551FD0(0, 0, dword_8B8DD4, dword_8B8DD8, v4) to save the screen; the message path runs only when it returns 0.
Look up the 'Screen Saved' string aScreenSaved in the string table via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aScreenSaved, byte_5EC4CC) for localization.
Copy aScreenSaved into the display buffer byte_5EC4CC, character by character, until the null terminator is copied.
Call CameraViewportRenderSetup(&unk_8AFFC8) to set up the camera viewport.
Call VehicleVisibilityCulling(this) on the current object.
Return the result of sub_557120(dword_8AFE88); sub_557120 appears in the raw source but is not present in the packet callee list.
